test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"They have discussed the issue already."

options.text: The issue was discussed by them.
The issue has been discussed already by them.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They have discussed the issue already."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the issue" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "have discussed" to "has been discussed" (present perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "them."
 
• Ensure the word "already" remains in the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The issue has been discussed already by them."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: **"The issue was discussed by them." – Incorrect tense (past simple instead of present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The issue discusses by them." – Incorrect structure.
 
• **Option 4: **"The issue had been discussed." – Incorrect tense (past perfect instead of present perfect passive).
